glyph ◆ (U+25C6): confirm Inter draws it; else Penpot substitutes a fallback font
root name: after the first section call the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name, or later calls create a duplicate root

annotations: estimated 1665 px high; the board is 1760 px (the kit's estimate 1704 px plus 56 px of the 96 px slack, capped at 1760 px). After touchTexts and relayout the footer 'page E42-D03 · board 02 · r1' must sit inside the root's 16 px bottom padding; if it is clipped, the board is already at the 1760 px cap, so shorten the Tokens block, never the copy
deviations: A live countdown (band badge, grace line, view-as banner) sets its clock in type.num.base as its own text node (D02:120; Appendix A L865 CMP-087 Tokens); the node's note carries the full §14 string.

SH-2's row (§4 L182) names no page: the board keeps SH-1's 'drawn over SCR-122 mid-edit' (L181), the edit SH-4 expires over (L184), as board 01 draws it (same strings, sizes and focus), so boards 01 and 02 differ only in the badge (DJ).

SCR-122 content this state does not need is drawn as neutral placeholders, both values the spec does not give for alex (the e-mail, display name and last sign-in, sub_002's environment, the limit values, the session row's device, IP and times, the three audit rows) and the effective-permission inputs UD-2 (L385) and UD-18 (L401) give: color.surface.hover bars, radius.control (pills radius.badge); boards 43 (UD-2), 55, 56, 97 and 100 draw that content. They are not a loading state (UD-1 is board 42).

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

A focus ring is a 2 px color.focus.ring inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs (4 px) padding, so it sits 2 px off the control (CMP-039) inside the wrapper's bounds; its radius is the next step (radius.card around radius.control); the wrapper adds 4 px on each side to the layout.
Links are colour + position only on the boards: cvsheet v1 texts have no underline.

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name is drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns it; §1 L97 gives only the sizes); the chrome binds color.surface.app with color.border.subtle dividers (no source names a chrome surface).
Board names carry Penpot's normalised ' / ' form (E42-D03 / 31 SCR-121 / populated · …) so cvsheet's find-or-create root matches on every section call; §0 L46-47 writes 'SCR-121/populated'.
